text: - `recover.rs` (`RecoverCashuWalletCommand`): both branches (idempotent "already loaded" and the happy-path decrypt chain) now spawn their own `std::thread` that runs the pass and **defers `RecordActionSuccess` until it completes** — so a caller polling balance right after `nmp.wallet.cashu.recover` returns sees the reconciled, UNSPENT-only balance, not a transiently optimistic one.
